title: Stanley William Hayter - Meduse  (Catalogue Raisonne Black/Moorhead 392)

events.q: a Hayter print retrospective at La Tortue Gallery, featuring this work
In the foreword to the catalogue that accompanied a Hayter print retrospective at La Tortue Gallery, featuring this work, Bryan Robertson, former director of London's Whitechapel Gallery wrote
It was actually created at the legendary Atelier 17, where Hayter made his greatest print innovations.

events.n: printed; the rest of the edition was printed later
